summary: Elastic N.V. filed an 8-K on August 27, 2026, reporting that director Caryn Marooney will not stand for reappointment at the October 2026 AGM. The departure is not due to disagreement with the company. Separately, the Board nominated Julia Liuson as a non-executive director, subject to shareholder vote under Dutch law. These are routine board refreshment events, not forced departures or strategic actions. No deal terms, prices, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a standard notice of director changes, with no special-situation catalysts to monitor.
